Turn the monthly sales CSV export into a weekly Markdown summary by region, generated every Monday morning.

## CONSTRAINTS
Python 3.12, standard library only.

## CURRENT TASK
**Task 1: Parse the monthly sales export** [role: data]
Read data/sales-*.csv into typed rows; report and skip bad rows.

## UPCOMING TASKS (do not work on these now)

- [ ] Task 3: Write the summary as a Markdown report
- [ ] Task 4: Send the report every Monday at 07:00

## Relevant codebase context

```README.md
# csv-report

The weekly sales summary.
```

```report.py
"""report.py — the weekly sales summary, from the monthly CSV export."""

import sys


def main(path: str) -> None:
    raise SystemExit("not written yet: " + path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "data/sales-2026-10.csv")
```
